pairs.subject: client-fetch-cache
pairs.evidence: src/v2/ui/HomeLists.tsx:43 The landing page keeps fetched lists in component-local state, so remounts start empty instead of painting retained results and revalidating behind them.

techniques.evidence: src/v2/ui/HomeLists.tsx:71 Every returned private-list result is retained without a declared admission hypothesis or reuse check.
src/v2/ui/HomeLists.tsx:42 Fetched rows occupy an unkeyed result slot; no centralized builder identifies the request and its answer-changing arguments.
src/v2/ui/HomeLists.tsx:77 Session resolution reruns the effect's identical public-list query; cleanup only suppresses writes, and no pending-request registry joins overlapping reads.
src/v2/covers/art.ts:29 The landing cover derivation is a small title hash; this path has no expensive parse or content-identity derivation cache.
src/v2/ui/HomeLists.tsx:67 Private-owner and public-starter reads are different questions, with no shared entry receiving competing reader policy claims.
src/v2/ui/HomeLists.tsx:53 The listing query is declared inside the component effect rather than an exported plain key/fetcher/default-policy definition reusable by loaders or prefetch.
src/v2/ui/HomeLists.tsx:25 Cards provide route navigation without warming a shared data read; the linked route's detail fetch runs in its client mount effect.
src/v2/ui/HomeLists.tsx:90 Rows already carry the detail title and topic, but remain local to the listing; the linked detail initializes as loading without borrowing a typed summary.
src/v2/ui/HomeLists.tsx:54 The reads use exact database predicates, with no resemblance lookup, similarity metric, or admission threshold.
src/v2/ui/HomeLists.tsx:49 Unrecognizable responses become empty arrays and are written into result state, conflating failed reads with authoritative emptiness; no freshness zones are declared.
src/v2/ui/HomeLists.tsx:43 Fetched starter rows die with the component; the browser-client singleton retains the transport client, not these results.
